style.name: Rain on Travertine
style.palette: ivory, lavender, moss, ultramarine, diluted ochre
style.shading: translucent wet washes with paper highlights
style.density: airy open compositions with pooled detail
style.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital watercolour on cold-pressed ivory paper, translucent wet-on-wet washes, pigment blooms and bleeding architectural edges. Very selective graphite marks anchor the small figures; lavender shade, moss cloth, diluted ochre stone and ultramarine water leave much paper white, with a small burnt-orange accent for hostile fire. Detail pools at silhouettes and landmarks while the ground dissolves into airy open washes. White-paper reserves keep effects and routes distinct. Mood is melancholy, fragile and contemplative; avoid opaque gouache, heavy outlines and smooth computer-rendered volume.

input.prompt:
STYLE: Hand-drawn digital watercolour on cold-pressed ivory paper, translucent wet-on-wet washes, pigment blooms and bleeding architectural edges. Very selective graphite marks anchor the small figures; lavender shade, moss cloth, diluted ochre stone and ultramarine water leave much paper white, with a small burnt-orange accent for hostile fire. Detail pools at silhouettes and landmarks while the ground dissolves into airy open washes. White-paper reserves keep effects and routes distinct. Mood is melancholy, fragile and contemplative; avoid opaque gouache, heavy outlines and smooth computer-rendered volume.

ACTION: A wide tactical overhead action-RPG combat screen seen from almost directly above, like a bird looking straight down: show a broad sandy arena floor, tiny foreshortened figures seen by their heads and shoulders, and only a narrow rim of low arena wall at the edges; no horizon, no visible sky, no frontal standing portraits. The player is a small adult Water mage near the lower centre, facing the upper right, surrounded by plenty of empty navigable sand: her RIGHT hand fires a thin cyan bolt toward a shield-bearing soldier above her, while her LEFT hand sustains a clearly separate cyan crescent on the ground immediately in front of HER feet; an orange orb arriving from the upper right breaks into a tight white spark on that crescent, and the ground behind her stays unshielded. A slinger is far to the left, a cinder hound circles on the right, and a small enemy mage at upper right is the source of the incoming orange orb; keep each figure small enough that its height is less than one tenth of the screen. A black-centred jagged red warning patch lies off to the right, distinct from the cyan casting trail and the player's defensive crescent. Draw compact, readable combat silhouettes and separated effect paths against the broad ground, with sparse Roman stonework and ward posts at the margins and quiet strips at top and bottom for later interface labels.

CONSTRAINTS: An original Roman-era elemental-mage prison game, drawn digitally by hand as a complete two-dimensional illustration. Roman-inspired tunics, sandals, limewashed masonry, terracotta, bronze collars and ward stones; invented people and symbols only. Entire scene in focus, clear silhouettes, readable at a reduced game-screen scale. No three-dimensional rendering, photography, modern equipment, existing franchise designs, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, panel grid or decorative outer frame.
